query: Generate an API key for my Turnkey organization
expected_behavior: Explains generating a P-256 key pair locally using any crypto library
Shows how to register the public key via POST /public/v1/submit/create_api_keys
Describes the X-Stamp authentication header mechanism

query: Create a new user with an API key via the Turnkey API
expected_behavior: Includes proper JSON body with userName and apiKeys array
Includes organizationId in the request body

query: Set up a sub-organization with a root user for a new customer
expected_behavior: Includes rootUsers with userName and apiKeys

query: Generate an encryption key for exporting a wallet
expected_behavior: Explains generating a P-256 HPKE key pair locally (client-side operation)
Mentions encryption keys are for secure wallet import/export
Notes these are separate from API keys

query: Set up a sub-organization with a root user and wallet for a new customer
expected_behavior: Includes rootUsers with API key configuration
Optionally includes wallet in the sub-org creation

query: How do I authenticate requests to the Turnkey API?
expected_behavior: Explains the X-Stamp header authentication mechanism
Describes signing the request body with a P-256 private key
Shows the stamp JSON structure with publicKey, signature, and scheme fields
